name: Tendril
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) necrotic damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.
